noveltyJustification: Iteration 008 isolated the admission gap; this pass supplies the complete base-state, fixed-point preview, typed refusal, repair-advice, independent G8, and exact-head serialization contract, including dirty-base quarantine and stale-preview retry semantics.
keyFindings: A verified replay at an exact head must be G8-clean before it is usable for normal admission; an already-invalid base is quarantined rather than attributed to the candidate

Every truth-, support-, relation-, scope-, staleness-, or nogood-changing candidate is applied to an isolated projection and settled to the pinned reducer fixed point before domain sequence allocation
Nogood declarations canonicalize existing distinct members and surface already-complete protected sets as unenforceable instead of silently recording or repairing them
Stable refusal binds semantic code, sorted violated sets, exact request/head/projection identities, and bounded repairs while allowing one separate audit deny and zero domain mutation
Repair suggestions are deterministic proof-checked candidate-local edits, never auto-actions or unproved globally minimal hitting sets
G8 remains an independent full-replay corruption, import, legacy, and reducer-drift backstop rather than ordinary admission control
A clean closure proof is valid only for one exact ledger head, reducer/policy/nogood identity, fence, and authority epoch; head movement rejects it and forces recomputation
